Michael Moriarty increased its stake in Spirit Airls Inc (SAVE) by 50.15% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Teewinot Capital Advisers Llc bought 77,200 shares as the company’s stock declined 17.76% with the market. The hedge fund run by Michael Moriarty held 231,137 shares of the transportation company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $10.37M, up from 153,937 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Teewinot Capital Advisers Llc who had been investing in Spirit Airls Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $2.50B market cap company. The stock increased 0.77% or $0.28 during the last trading session, reaching $36.67. About 624,372 shares traded. Spirit Airlines, Inc. (NASDAQ:SAVE) has declined 27.05% since May 24, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 38.60% the S&P500.
Ibm Retirement Fund increased its stake in Facebook Inc (FB) by 4.87% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. The institutional investor held 60,787 shares of the technology company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $11.71M, up from 57,963 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Ibm Retirement Fund who had been investing in Facebook Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $539.59 billion market cap company. It has underperformed by 3.07% the S&P500.
